title: Resend deliverability grid
description: A glow-framed band with the light pooled towards its end: a left-aligned lit two-line title, then a three-by-three grid of line icons, widely spaced grotesk titles and short grey copy (icon beside the title on phones). Each item rises 20px and fades in as it scrolls into view, column by column.
notes: the reveal is a CSS view() timeline inside @supports; without it (or with reduced motion) everything shows in place
